build_Build_task: create a Build task to place blocks from a schematic at a given origin in the Minecraft world
create_Move_task: create a Move task to navigate the agent to a target block position using A-star pathfinding
create_Destroy_task: create a Destroy task to dig and remove blocks specified in a schematic block list
create_Dig_task: create a Dig task to excavate a rectangular region with given origin, width, length, and depth
create_Spawn_task: create a Spawn task to place a mob entity at a target position using a spawn egg item
